why: The Czech Astronomy Olympiad is a named extracurricular educational competition and annual initiative, not a general instructional element.
name: Czech Astronomy Olympiad (CzAO)
product_description: An annual multi-round national astronomy competition for Czech secondary- and high-school students, organised by the Czech Astronomical Society.

why: This is a named online platform and set of competition-administration modules for the Czech Astronomy Olympiad, not a general instructional element.
name: CzAO online platform
product_description: The Czech Astronomy Olympiad organizers' website provides online competition solving, scanned-work submission, and remote grading for participating students and teachers.

why: These are a reusable, named series of astronomy problem booklets produced by CzAO, rather than a general instructional element; open access alone does not establish the licensing permissions required by Open Educational Resources (The 5Rs).
name: Open Access English-language booklets of CzAO competition problems with solved problems
product_description: CzAO's open-access English-language booklet series translates astronomy competition problems and provides worked solutions for international astronomy-competition students and educators.
